items.title: Marriott International (MAR) Enters Laos With Luxury Collection Debut In Luang Prabang
items.summary: Marriott International (NasdaqGS:MAR) has entered Laos with the opening of La Résidence Phou Vao in Luang Prabang. The property joins Marriott’s Luxury Collection portfolio and is located in a UNESCO World Heritage city in northern Laos. La Résidence Phou Vao expands Marriott’s presence in Southeast Asia into a new national market that targets high-end leisure tourism. La Résidence Phou Vao is only one part of the bigger story at Marriott International as the group pursues wider priorities...
